cards.answer: Lillia is a mobile fighter-mage with an AP damage focus. Ability hits build movement speed and apply maximum-health magic damage over time, while Q's outer edge adds true damage. Her ultimate can put Dream Dust-marked champions to sleep.
cards.counterplay: Limit repeated spell hits, avoid Q's outer edge, and give her space while marked with Dream Dust.
